answer: Anchor reading proof: at each deal the River beacon draws two offsets at 20 % and 80 % of the answer length. The grader returns, verbatim, the five words after the nearest sentence start at each offset, plus the score. A wrong quote voids the seal and pays nothing; two voids in 10 seals drop the grader out of the Ferrous tier, the only tier eligible for 7 seat panels. Expected reading rises from about 20 % to at least 80 % of the text. Cheapest bypass: a script that extracts quotes without judging, so the Summit audit regrades 5 % of seals and flags quote correct scores off by 2 points.
